summary.text: Francesca Hong is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 76, based in Madison, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2020.
She serves on the Audit, Education, Rules, and Government Operations, Accountability, and Transparency committees.

paragraphs.text: Hong was born in Madison, Wisconsin, on November 4, 1988, and has one child.
She graduated from Madison West High School in 2007 and attended the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
The Legislature's page lists her occupation as chef and bartender.

Her listed memberships include the board and executive committee of the AAPI Coalition of Wisconsin, the presidency of the Rooted Wisconsin board, and the vice presidency of the Kennedy Heights Community Center board.
She is a cofounder of the Dane County Food Collective, the Culinary Ladies Collective and Korean American Day Madison.
